caseNameFull: LIFE ASSURANCE CO. OF PENNSYLVANIA v. PENNSYLVANIA
attorneys: Harry J. Rubin and Morris J. Dean for appellant., Walter E. Alessandroni, Attorney General of Pennsylvania, and George W. Keitel and Eugene J. Anastasio, Deputy Attorneys General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Fortas took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
